I have a credit chip to pay for the engines which are off an old Y-wing model. You'll need to give him the credit chip.|[[W. Wald|Wald]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WW" />}}
'''Qord D'Baelor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wonderful! I have transferred the appropriate credits to Wald's accounts. Wald said he is waiting for you back at Watto's shop.|Qord D'Baelor, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WW" />}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Qord D'Baelor was doing business with the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="SWG:WW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he could be found in the bar of the [[Mos Espa Starport]]. While here, he expected a delivery of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] parts from [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. Unfortunately, a local [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] of teenagers called the [[Laser Flits]] ambushed the delivery of swoop parts before they could reach D'Baelor. [[W. Wald]], overburdened by this turn of events, relied on a helpful [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to retrieve the ten swoop parts from [[Laser Flit Hangout|their hideout]] within the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SWG:WW" />

Fortunately for Wald and his customer, the spacer succeeded in retrieving the parts. In addition, Wald also wished to buy [[Sublight engine/Legends|engines]] from D'Baelor, which were retrieved from an old [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] model. In addition to delivering the swoop parts to D'Baelor, Wald also tasked the spacer with giving him a [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]] to pay for the engine parts. When the spacer found D'Baelor, he was thrilled to have been given the swoop parts, and was more than willing to part with his Y-wing engines.<ref name="SWG:WW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qord D'Baelor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> He was added as part of the quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Wald's Woes|Wald's Woes]]" with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> Players who performed a series of quests for Wald had to deliver and retrieve vehicle parts from D'Baelor.<ref name="SWG:WW" />
